title: स्वागतम् — Welcome to Sanskrit Manthan
author: संस्कृतमन्थनम् · Sanskrit Manthan
excerpt: A workshop of Indian Knowledge Systems: read, search, learn and share — with Bodhinī as your guide.
t: यथा पिण्डे तथा ब्रह्माण्डे — as in the small, so in the vast. Sanskrit Manthan (संस्कृतमन्थनम्) is a bhāratīya-jñāna-paramparā-kāryaśālā — a workshop of Indian Knowledge Systems. Its aim is simple: to let anyone read the sources in the original, understand them, and live with them today. What you will find here Books — more than 150 works in Sanskrit and Telugu: the Purāṇas, Rāmāyaṇa and Mahābhārata in singable verse, kāvyas on the śāstras, Pāṇinian grammar and the Nāṭyaśāstra, kośas, stotras, education and vacana-kāvyas. Search the sources — every pāda of classical kāvya, sūtra and kārikā texts, the Vedas and Upaniṣads, subhāṣitas, the Itihāsa–Purāṇa and the śāstras, in Devanāgarī, Telugu or Roman. Kośa and grammar — dictionaries, every noun and verb form with its Pāṇinian derivation, lessons and games. Greetings — original Sanskrit ślokas for festivals and occasions, with meanings in the languages of India, made into a card with your own photo. Meet Bodhinī Tap the lady in the saree at the bottom of any page. Bodhinī — “she who awakens understanding” — answers in Sanskrit, Telugu, Hindi or English: she finds a verse from its first words, opens Gītā 2.47 or Pāṇini 1.1.1, shows a book, gives a word's meaning, explains a grammar lesson, reads ślokas aloud, and takes you to any page — by typing or by voice. Keep it on your phone Add Sanskrit Manthan to your home screen (Bodhinī ▸ “Install app”) and save the indexes for offline reading. A new article, a new śloka and new books will appear here regularly. शुभमस्तु।
